lowres_ok: IGN's 1920x1080 copy of HoYoverse's official trailer (IGN video page, 23 Oct); HoYoverse's own YouTube channel is not reachable here; 1080p is the best file found
note: Primary: HoYoLAB official 'Version 7.2 Update Maintenance Preview' (post 47283828, 2 Nov 03:10Z): maintenance 4 Nov 06:00 UTC+8 (02:00 Dubai), about 5 hours, pre-install available (PC 8 GB, mobile 3 GB), compensation 300 Primogems for AR 5+. Footage: IGN 1920 copy of the official 7.2 trailer, 110 to 126 s (the 23 Oct Reel used the Snezhnaya city, Mitya, Valeriy and throne shots from other stretches). Launch-eve update story; the 7.2 date itself ran on 23 Oct. v2: shots 4 and 5 moved to the dark cave (98 s) and night-castle (70 s) scenes because the purple motion blur at 118.8 s made the line unreadable; the music stem is continuous, so shot order is free.
